title: US8009460B2 'Device and method for using dynamic cell plate sensing in a DRAM memory cell' (also US 5991216 / US 6104652 'Method and memory device for dynamic cell plate sensing with AC equilibrate')
query: DRAM cell plate line sensing segmented divided plate bitline clamped sense charge on plate 3D DRAM
supports: Cell plate divided into lines each paired with a bit line feeding a sense amplifier; AC equilibration of bitline/plate-line pairs; plate-voltage drift can corrupt other cells sharing the plate. No 3D-DRAM plate-strip sensing found (via search snippet)
